args.title: Freight Pricing Summary (2026) + Companion Piece
args.body:
- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges are now tied to weekly diesel price movements.
- Shippers who diversified by splitting volume across three carriers achieved the lowest overall freight costs.
- Together, this suggests a strategy of multi-carrier allocation combined with contract-rate stability could hedge against spot market volatility going forward.
